1.mascotDialogue: Same visited-tracking idea as BFS, an entirely different order of motion — DFS descends deeply first, and returns only when it truly must.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 6 is the whole difference from BFS — instead of placing the neighbor in a queue for later, DFS recurses into it at once, descending before ever returning to the next sibling.

3.mascotDialogue: Same graph as the BFS lesson, an entirely different order — 3 is visited before 2, because DFS committed to 1 first, and followed that path all the way down.

4.mascotDialogue: DFS's recursive elegance is also its greatest risk — forget the visited check, and 'go deep' has no floor to reach. It simply keeps calling itself, without end.
